svg.title: Plan → implement: active elapsed time
svg.desc: Every scored workflow's active elapsed time in minutes (circles), with median (tick) and interquartile range (band), against the 30-minute workflow ceiling. Excludes independent evaluation and quota waits. Data table: pi-elapsed.csv.
